prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Create a square reaction-meme image of a butter-yellow, absurdly chubby 3D cartoon cat caught in explosive belly laughter. Its huge rounded head merges into a pear-shaped body with almost no neck. Give it small triangular cat ears, a tiny feline nose, short whiskers, and stubby paws resting against its enormous belly. The head tips backward, cheeks bulge upward, and both eyes squeeze shut into curved crescent slits. An outrageously wide, gaping mouth dominates the lower face: a deep black interior with a small pink tongue at the bottom. Make the laughter look helpless, loud, and slightly ridiculous, with the whole body seeming to shake. Preserve a squat, inflated, soft rubber-toy silhouette, using minimal fur detail and warm yellow shading. Center the face and upper body in a tight, slightly low-angle crop against a blurred neutral background. Soft lighting, deliberately modest 3D animation quality, slight screenshot blur and compression. No text, accessories, horns, or scales.
